ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with a predominance of low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels comprising approximately 80% of the surface area and high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels comprising approximately 20% in localized clusters and linear formations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Concentrated high-intensity white pixel clusters are located at the distal tips of both lobes. Significant high-intensity linear clusters (parallel vertical lines) are visible on the mid-left lobe. Scattered white punctate spots are distributed across the lower-center region near the peduncle connection.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees and a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge. The amplitude of variations increases significantly toward the distal tips, where the boundary becomes highly irregular due to epibiont accumulation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading from the median notch to the outer tips, with a slight convex swell in the mid-section of each lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosettes) are visible, particularly a cluster of four near the lower-right median notch and scattered individual rosettes across the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct sets of parallel, high-intensity linear scratches (rake marks) are present on the left lobe. The primary set consists of four distinct vertical lines, while a secondary set of fainter lines is visible closer to the left tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive three-dimensional epibiont colonization (barnacles) on both distal tips, creating significant protrusion from the natural fluke boundary. Multiple sets of parallel rake marks suggesting previous inter-species or intra-species interaction.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of brownish-orange stalked appendages attached to the barnacle clusters on the distal tips, likely representing secondary epibionts or parasitic organisms.
